title: Vision Theatre Ceremony & Celebration Grand Reopening 8/20/2026
description:
A historic Leimert Park landmark is stepping into a new era. Following a nearly $40 million restoration, the Vision Theatre has been transformed into a state-of-the-art, 729-seat performing arts center in the heart of South Los Angeles.

Originally opened in 1932 as the Leimert Theatre, the Art Deco venue was renamed the Vision Theatre after actress Marla Gibbs purchased it in 1990. Its restoration preserves historic features, including the auditorium’s ceiling mural, while adding modern production systems and ADA-accessible improvements.

The Vision Theatre will operate through a partnership between the City of Los Angeles Department of Cultural Affairs and WACO Theater Center. Programming will showcase local, emerging, national, and international artists, along with community events, arts education, and City-partnered cultural programs.

The ribbon-cutting celebration honored the theater’s history and community legacy through land and labor acknowledgments, a libation ceremony, a blessing of the space, and performances by the Spirit Chorale of Los Angeles and Karen A. Clark.

WACO Theater Center’s grand opening is planned for November 2026, followed by the launch of its first full season in February 2027.
